Indian Pilot Smit Machchhar Attacked, Receives Israeli Bravery Award

Indian pilot Smit Machchhar, who flies for Flydubai, was stabbed in an attack. The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has registered a case under the Anti-Hijacking Law and the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA). In recognition of his actions, Israeli President Isaac Herzog has invited Machchhar to receive Israel's highest civilian bravery honor, the "Hero of Humanity" award.
